members.name: banking77
members.instructions: A customer sent this message to a digital bank's support chat. Which intent does the message express? Pick the single most specific intent.

criteria.activate_my_card: How to activate a newly received card, or the card cannot be activated.
criteria.age_limit: Minimum or maximum age to open an account or use the service; can children/teens have accounts.
criteria.apple_pay_or_google_pay: Using Apple Pay, Google Pay, Android Pay or a smartwatch with the card or to top up; it not working.
criteria.atm_support: Which ATMs accept the card, where to find an ATM, ATM locations.
criteria.automatic_top_up: Automatic / auto top-up feature: whether it exists, how to set it up or turn it off, how it works.
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer: Customer moved money INTO their own account by bank transfer and it is not showing / balance unchanged; includes the recurring wording 'I made a transfer from my UK account, how long does it take, it is not showing'.
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash: Customer deposited a cheque or cash, or just says they 'deposited' / 'put money into' their account without saying how, but the balance has not updated / funds not showing; cheque slow to clear.
criteria.beneficiary_not_allowed: Cannot add a beneficiary/payee, or a beneficiary is not allowed or was rejected.
criteria.cancel_transfer: Wants to cancel or reverse a transfer or transaction they made (by mistake).
criteria.card_about_to_expire: Card is expiring or has expired; getting a new card to replace the old one, including fees or faster delivery for the new replacement card.
criteria.card_acceptance: Where the card can be used, whether a shop/merchant accepts it, card not accepted at a merchant.
criteria.card_arrival: An ordered physical card has not arrived yet in the post / tracking a card that was sent.
criteria.card_delivery_estimate: How long card delivery takes, when a new card will arrive, can it arrive by a certain date, delivery options.
criteria.card_linking: Linking or adding a card in the app (e.g. the new card that arrived, or an existing card); reactivating a found card.
criteria.card_not_working: The card generally doesn't work / stopped working / is broken or damaged, without describing a particular declined payment.
criteria.card_payment_fee_charged: Charged an extra fee for a card payment / using the card; also vague fee complaints like hidden fees, too many fees, 'I thought it was free'.
criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: A card payment or purchase (explicitly described as a payment/purchase/transaction, not merely a 'charge') that the customer did not make or does not remember buying.
criteria.card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate: Complaint or doubt that a wrong or bad exchange rate was applied to a past payment, purchase or currency exchange (not a cash withdrawal); 'got less than expected', 'was the rate correct for my last transaction'.
criteria.card_swallowed: The ATM kept / swallowed / retained the card.
criteria.cash_withdrawal_charge: Fee charged for withdrawing cash at an ATM; why charged for a withdrawal.
criteria.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: A cash/ATM withdrawal in the account that the customer did not make.
criteria.change_pin: How to change or reset the card PIN (customer already has a PIN and wants a different one).
criteria.compromised_card: Card may be compromised / someone else may be using it / card details stolen or skimmed (card itself not necessarily lost).
criteria.country_support: Which countries the service or card is available/supported in; using the account when living abroad.
criteria.declined_card_payment: A card payment/purchase was declined or rejected; the card did not work when paying in a shop or online.
criteria.declined_cash_withdrawal: ATM cash withdrawal was declined / not authorised / couldn't get money out.
criteria.declined_transfer: The customer says an outgoing transfer was declined, rejected or refused.
criteria.direct_debit_payment_not_recognised: A direct debit the customer does not recognise; also any 'charge' the customer didn't make or doesn't know: 'unknown charge', 'unauthorised charge', 'my account was charged for something I didn't make', 'dispute a charge'.
criteria.disposable_card_limits: Limits/restrictions on disposable virtual cards (how many uses, how many cards).
criteria.edit_personal_details: Change personal details: name, address, phone, email, account details/information.
criteria.exchange_charge: Fees for exchanging currency (FX fees) only.
criteria.exchange_rate: General, forward-looking questions about which exchange rates are used, where to see them, how they are calculated (not about cash withdrawals).
criteria.exchange_via_app: How to exchange money between currencies in the app; can I exchange to currency X.
criteria.extra_charge_on_statement: A specific small extra amount (an extra £1, $1 or €1) on the statement or app, even if unrecognised or pending.
criteria.failed_transfer: An outgoing transfer failed or did not go through; the customer cannot make a transfer or something is going wrong with it (without saying it was declined).
criteria.fiat_currency_support: Which (fiat) currencies the account can hold or exchange, currencies supported.
criteria.get_disposable_virtual_card: How to get/create a disposable virtual card; who can get one.
criteria.get_physical_card: How to get a physical card (e.g. when they have a virtual one); PIN not received yet, where is my PIN, cannot find the card PIN.
criteria.getting_spare_card: Getting an additional/extra/spare/another card, for self or family member; how many cards one can have.
criteria.getting_virtual_card: Anything about getting a (non-disposable) virtual card: how to get or order one, its cost, or an ordered virtual card that has not come through yet.
criteria.lost_or_stolen_phone: Phone lost, stolen or left behind; using the account without the phone.
criteria.order_physical_card: How to order a (physical) card, ordering a card to a country, card ordering fees.
criteria.passcode_forgotten: Forgot the app passcode/password; reset passcode.
criteria.pending_card_payment: A card payment/purchase is still pending or has not gone through yet; why pending, how long until it completes.
criteria.pending_cash_withdrawal: A cash withdrawal is pending / shows as pending.
criteria.pending_top_up: A top-up is pending / not yet completed / topped-up funds not visible yet.
criteria.pending_transfer: A transfer shows as pending / still processing / in progress, or the customer has simply been waiting a long time for a transfer; also money someone sent to the customer that they cannot see yet.
criteria.pin_blocked: PIN blocked / card or account blocked after entering the wrong PIN too many times; how to unblock.
criteria.receiving_money: How to receive money / get paid into the account (salary, from others), receiving transfers.
criteria.Refund_not_showing_up: A refund from a merchant has not appeared in the account / still waiting for a refund.
criteria.request_refund: Wants to request or get a refund for something bought; how refunds work.
criteria.reverted_card_payment?: A card payment was reverted, cancelled, returned, or the money came back to the account.
criteria.supported_cards_and_currencies: Which cards (credit/debit types, brands such as American Express) and currencies are supported for top-up or payments, including why a particular card brand doesn't work for adding money.
criteria.top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge: Fee for topping up by bank transfer.
criteria.top_up_by_card_charge: Fee for topping up using a card.
criteria.top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: Topping up / depositing with cash or cheque: can I, how.
criteria.top_up_failed: A top-up attempt failed, was declined or gave an error / didn't work.
criteria.top_up_limits: Limits on top-up amounts or number of top-ups.
criteria.top_up_reverted: A top-up was reverted / reversed, or the top-up seemed to go through (money taken) but the account was not credited / the money disappeared.
criteria.topping_up_by_card: How to top up with a card; card top-up process; card top-up not showing.
criteria.transaction_charged_twice: The same transaction/payment charged twice, duplicate charge.
criteria.transfer_fee_charged: Charged a fee for a transfer; also a bare 'why was I charged (a fee)?' with no context, and fees for using the account or card abroad.
criteria.transfer_into_account: How to transfer/add money into this account from another account or bank.
criteria.transfer_not_received_by_recipient: Money the customer sent to someone else (landlord, friend, retailer) has not arrived on the recipient side; also generic 'I transferred some money but it is not here yet / taking too long' without saying it was to their own account.
criteria.transfer_timing: General question about how long transfers take to arrive (especially incoming transfers from the US or Europe), with no specific problem described.
criteria.unable_to_verify_identity: Trying to verify identity but it fails / cannot complete verification.
criteria.verify_my_identity: How to verify identity; what documents are needed; how long verification takes.
criteria.verify_source_of_funds: Verifying or showing the source of funds / where money comes from.
criteria.verify_top_up: Top-up verification code / verifying a card used for top-up.
criteria.virtual_card_not_working: Virtual card not working / being declined.
criteria.visa_or_mastercard: Is the card Visa or Mastercard; choosing card brand.
criteria.why_verify_identity: Why identity verification is required, whether it is necessary, what happens if I use the account before verification is finished; why so much personal information is needed.
criteria.wrong_amount_of_cash_received: ATM gave less (or different) cash than requested/recorded.
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: Any question or complaint about the exchange rate for cash withdrawals / getting cash at ATMs abroad, including general questions about that rate.

instructions.task: Route this message from a digital bank's support chat to the one intent category it belongs to. Choose the category whose definition best matches what the customer is asking about.
labelling_conventions: Fees: only a bare 'why was I charged?' with no other detail is transfer_fee_charged. 'Charged extra' or an extra £1/$1/€1 is extra_charge_on_statement. Vague fee complaints (hidden fees, too many fees, 'I thought it was free', 'will I get extra charges') are card_payment_fee_charged. A 'charge' the customer didn't make is direct_debit_payment_not_recognised.
'I made a transfer from my UK account, how long does it take, it is not showing' is balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer.
'I am waiting for a transfer from the US/Europe, how long?' is transfer_timing.

A transfer into the customer's own account that is not showing is balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer; a generic 'I transferred some money but it is not here yet' is transfer_not_received_by_recipient.
Whether a card brand (e.g. American Express) can be used to add money, or why it doesn't work for that, is supported_cards_and_currencies.
Missing PIN / where is my PIN / setting the PIN of a new physical card is get_physical_card.
A specific extra £1/$1/€1 charge is extra_charge_on_statement even when the customer does not recognise it.
Money the customer 'put into' or 'deposited' into their account, method unstated, that is not showing is balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash_deposit.
Any exchange-rate question about getting cash at an ATM is wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal.

criteria.transfer_fee_charged: Charged a fee for a transfer; also a bare 'why was I charged (a fee)?' with no context, and fees for using the account or card abroad.
criteria.transfer_into_account: How to transfer/add money into this account from another account or bank.
criteria.transfer_not_received_by_recipient: Money the customer sent to someone else (landlord, friend, retailer) has not arrived on the recipient side; also generic 'I transferred some money but it is not here yet / taking too long' without saying it was to their own account.
criteria.transfer_timing: General question about how long transfers take to arrive (especially incoming transfers from the US or Europe), with no specific problem described.
criteria.unable_to_verify_identity: Trying to verify identity but it fails / cannot complete verification.
criteria.verify_my_identity: How to verify identity; what documents are needed; how long verification takes.
criteria.verify_source_of_funds: Verifying or showing the source of funds / where money comes from.
criteria.verify_top_up: Top-up verification code / verifying a card used for top-up.
criteria.virtual_card_not_working: Virtual card not working / being declined.
criteria.visa_or_mastercard: Is the card Visa or Mastercard; choosing card brand.
criteria.why_verify_identity: Why identity verification is required, whether it is necessary, what happens if I use the account before verification is finished; why so much personal information is needed.
criteria.wrong_amount_of_cash_received: ATM gave less (or different) cash than requested/recorded.
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: Any question or complaint about the exchange rate for cash withdrawals / getting cash at ATMs abroad, including general questions about that rate.
